title: 第二章 这游戏有毒！
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
“对了，老板你刚刚说什么表？”回过神来，小雅问。
“哦，没什么，我说着玩的……”
沐游很快镇定了下来，不动声色的将怀表塞进了口袋：“今天估计也没什么客人了，你先回去吧，剩下的我待会儿收拾。”
“那好吧，我先下班了。明天见。”
“明天见。”
目送着小雅离开，沐游脸上的微笑才渐渐转为了严肃。
他在前台电脑上调取了今天的监控录像。
时间倒流这种怪事出现在了眼皮子底下，他可没心思干别的，现在必须要确认一下，那个U盘到底是谁放的。
沐游拉动着录像快进，结果一整个上午，前台的桌面上都没有任何东西。
一直到下午四点十五分，桌面上才忽然凭空出现了一个U盘！
是的，就是凭空出现！
前台周围没有任何人靠近的情况下，上一秒桌上还空空如也，结果下一帧，就突兀的冒出了一个U盘！
越发意识到不对的沐游，又试着搜索了一下《愚者》这个名字，然而搜出来的全是不相关的东西，网上根本没有关于这款游戏的记录。
“果然有问题……”
沐游皱了皱眉，果断放弃了继续追溯游戏来源的想法，以这种超自然游戏的能耐，不想被人追查的话，估计他做多少努力也是白搭。
而且，这游戏现在显示是内测版本，说明以后极有可能会公测。
也就是说，在未来的某一天，全球的人类都能下载到这个游戏……
沐游不敢想下去了，如果真的发展到了那一天，那这个游戏，一定会给世界带来大变！
而现在，他不过是比较好运的先大多数人一步接触到了这个游戏，那么他就更应该积极的探索游戏内容，尽可能在游戏公测之前掌握更多的信息。
【月光的照耀下，你走出荆棘丛，踏上了森林中的小路。】

【裹雪的落叶被长靴踩过发出悲鸣，轻微声响便能惊动鸟群鸣叫，猫头鹰的叫声似远似近，此起彼伏。这无一不提醒着你，这片森林中危机四伏。在这里停留的越久，你就会越危险，你最好尽快找到附近的村庄。】
选项弹出，【出发】和【继续停留】。
沐游选择了‘出发’。
【月光的指引下，你踏上了路途。】
【你的面前出现了三条路。】
【左边这条路上，布满了萤火点点，月光的辉映下宛若梦境。恍惚之中，你似乎看到前方树杈上，有一位长着翅膀的精灵仙女在朝你低唤：‘过来吧，冒险者，我可以实现你的愿望。’】
【中间这条路上，躺着一个醉醺醺的壮汉，手里提着斧子和酒瓶，身上穿着条形的囚服——他很可能是一个危险的逃犯，你最好远离他！】
【右边这条路上，一片荒凉，看不到任何人影，蜿蜒的小路一直延伸进了黑暗深处。虽然没有任何阻碍，但你的直觉提醒你，在那黑暗之中，或许隐藏着更致命的危险。】
【那么，愚者，你准备踏上哪边的路？】
沐游看着下方三个选项，左，右，中。
首先排除中！
中路上这逃犯的描述，一看就免不了一场恶战的样子。
而左边这条路的描述，应该是在暗示他前面有个能实现愿望的仙女。
对于开局就出现这种运气逆天的选项，沐游其实也很怀疑，这更像是个陷阱。
但谁让他能回溯时间呢，试一试又不会亏。
他的怀表可以回溯到五秒之前，然后冷却时间也是五秒，刚好形成一个闭环。也就是说，只要当前选项的文本弹出时间不超过五秒，他就可以在这个选项内无限循环，将所有选项的结果全部尝试出来。
沐游选择了【左】。
【勇敢的冒险者，你选择了回应仙女的呼唤，踏上了去往左边的路。】
【你满含期待的踩在荧光遍地的雪地上，朝坐在树杈上的那道曼妙身影走去。】
【但靠近之后，你才发现那道身影并不是精灵仙女，而是一只倒挂的梦魇蝙蝠！梦魇蝙蝠最喜欢的就是在夜晚制造幻象，吸引过往的路人靠近，然后吸食他们的脑髓。】

【你意识到这是一个陷阱，想要逃跑，但为时已晚，梦魇蝙蝠朝你飞来。】
【你被梦魇蝙蝠咬死了！】
【你已死亡！寿命-1，剩余寿命57年。】
淦，就知道没这么顺利！
沐游暗骂一声，不过他首先注意到的却是最后一句提示：剩余寿命57年！
这里的寿命，该不会是真的寿命吧……
如果是别的游戏，沐游绝不会产生这种无端联想，但眼前这个诡异的游戏，发生什么他都不意外。
这么说，他还剩57年可活？
而如果这个猜测是真的，也就是说，他在这游戏中每死亡一次，就会永久损失一年的寿命……
真，氪命游戏！
他就说这游戏怎么这么大方，开局就送他一件逆天的魔法怀表，原来代价是要他玩命啊！
沐游吸了口气，这些想法也就在一念之间飘过脑海，眼看着时间快要超过五秒，他急忙按下怀表开关。
周围的一切再次倒流，瞬间转回了五秒前的状态。
而游戏中也的选项，也重回了刚才的岔路口。
不过，这游戏似乎能感应到怀表倒转了时间，文本并没有直接变回去，而是悄然出现了一些变化。
【幸运的愚者，你的遗物救了你一命，避免了你的死亡。】
【时光倒流，你回到了刚才的路口，请重新作出你的选择。】
下方还是左，中，右三个选项。
明知左边有蝙蝠，沐游当然不会再去送，这次他选择了走右边。
【你选择踏上了右边这条荒凉的小路。】

【前方毫无阻碍，似乎一路坦途。】
【路边忽然蹿出一只黑斑蜘蛛，粘稠的蛛网朝你扑来，你动弹不得。】
【你被黑斑蜘蛛咬死了！】
【你已死亡！寿命-1，剩余寿命57年。】
靠，又猜错了？
沐游傻眼。
正确答案居然是中间的逃犯？
……还是说，连逃犯都是错的，这选项其实根本就没有正确答案，选谁都是死？
不管了，先回溯再说！
【时光倒流，你又一次回到了熟悉的三岔路口。】
【连续的死亡挫折没有打垮你，那么，愚者，这次你又准备去往哪条路？】
沐游忐忑的点击了‘中’。
【你选择朝中间的逃犯走去，远远的向他求救，希望他能带你回村子。但在风声鹤唳的逃犯眼中，此时任何人的靠近都只会让他情绪更加激动，他提起了斧子，看向你的眼睛里，杀机涌动……】
这文本一出现，沐游就觉得不妙：怕不是又要遭！
幸好，还没完。
【只可惜，这逃犯是个怂逼，到最后也没敢真动手，看着你靠近，他慌不择路的逃离了现场。你，活了下来。】
“靠，什么叫‘只可惜’？我活下来让你很失望是吧？”
沐游暗骂一声，同时心中长长的松了口气。
这游戏虽然文案嘴臭了点，但看来还算有点下限，没有真给他设置什么必死的选项。
话说，这开局的选项也实在是太有迷惑性了，也就是他能回溯时间，才避免了损失。

想到这里，沐游对自己随机到的‘时光怀表’，不由更加满意：貌似误打误撞的，随机到了一个相当逆天的遗物啊！
这种文字冒险游戏，本来就是让玩家在文本中做出一个个的选择，每一个选择都将带来不同的结果。
而能无限回档，就意味这他在游戏中遭遇的任何选项，都可以保证做出最佳选择！
还有比这能力更适合这个游戏的么？
content_en:
"By the way, boss, what did you say just now?" Xiaoya asked after coming back to her senses.
"Oh, it's nothing, I was just joking..."
Mu You quickly calmed down and quietly stuffed his pocket watch into his pocket: "There probably won't be many guests today. You should go back first. I'll take care of the rest later."
"Okay, I'll get off work first. See you tomorrow."
"See you tomorrow."
Watching Xiaoya leave, the smile on Mu You's face gradually turned serious.
He retrieved today's surveillance video on the front desk computer.
A strange thing like time reversal appeared right in front of his eyes. He had no intention of doing anything else. Now he had to confirm who put the USB flash drive.
Mu You pulled the video to fast forward, and found that there was nothing on the desk at the front desk all morning.
It wasn't until 4:15 in the afternoon that a USB flash drive suddenly appeared on the desktop!
Yes, it just appeared out of thin air!
When there was no one around the front desk, the table was empty one second, but in the next frame, a USB flash drive suddenly appeared!
Mu You, who became more and more aware that something was wrong, tried to search for the name "The Fool" again, but all he found were irrelevant things, and there was no record of this game on the Internet at all.
"There is indeed a problem..."
Mu You frowned and decisively gave up the idea of continuing to trace the origin of the game. With the ability of this kind of supernatural game, if he didn't want to be traced, it is estimated that all his efforts would be in vain.
Moreover, this game is now shown as a closed beta version, indicating that it is very likely to be released to the public beta in the future.
In other words, one day in the future, everyone around the world will be able to download this game...
Mu You didn't dare to think about it anymore. If it really develops to that day, then this game will definitely bring big changes to the world!
But now, he is just lucky enough to be exposed to this game before most people, so he should actively explore the game content and try his best to master as much information as possible before the game is released for public testing.
[Under the moonlight, you walked out of the thorn bush and stepped onto the path in the forest. 】
[The fallen leaves wrapped in snow scream when they are stepped on by long boots. The slightest sound can startle a flock of birds to chirp. The hoots of owls seem to be far away and close, one after another. This all reminds you that there are dangers in this forest. The longer you stay here, the more dangerous you'll be, and you'd better find a nearby village as soon as possible. 】
The options pop up, [Departure] and [Continue to Stay].
Mu You chose ‘leave’.
[Under the guidance of the moonlight, you embark on the road. 】
【Three roads appear in front of you. 】
[The road on the left is covered with dots of fireflies, and it looks like a dream under the moonlight. In a trance, you seem to see a winged elf on the tree branch in front of you, whispering to you: 'Come here, adventurer, I can make your wish come true. ’]
[On the middle road, there is a drunken strong man lying on the road, holding an ax and a wine bottle in his hand, and wearing a striped prison uniform - he is probably a dangerous fugitive, you'd better stay away from him! 】
[The road on the right is desolate, with no one in sight, and the winding path extends into the depths of darkness. Although there is no obstacle, your intuition reminds you that there may be a more deadly danger hidden in the darkness. 】
[So, Fool, which road are you going to take? 】
Mu You looked at the three options below, left, right, and center.
Excluded first!
From the description of the fugitive on the middle road, one cannot avoid the appearance of a fierce battle.
The description of the road on the left should imply that there is a fairy in front of him who can grant wishes.
Mu You was actually very skeptical about such a luck-defying option at the beginning. It was more like a trap.
But who allows him to go back in time? He won't lose money if he gives it a try.
His pocket watch can go back five seconds, and when it cools downThe time is also five seconds, which just forms a closed loop. In other words, as long as the text pop-up time of the current option does not exceed five seconds, he can loop infinitely within this option and try out the results of all options.
Mu You chose [Left].
[Brave adventurer, you chose to answer the fairy's call and embarked on the road to the left. 】
[You step on the fluorescent snow full of expectation and walk towards the graceful figure sitting on the branch of the tree. 】
[But when you get closer, you realize that the figure is not an elf fairy, but an upside-down nightmare bat! What Nightmare Bats like most is to create illusions at night, attract passers-by to come closer, and then suck their brains. 】
[You realize this is a trap and want to escape, but it's too late. The Nightmare Bat flies towards you. 】
[You were bitten to death by a nightmare bat! 】
【You are dead! Lifespan -1, remaining lifespan is 57 years. 】
Gan, I knew it wouldn’t go so well!
Mu You cursed secretly, but the first thing he noticed was the last reminder: 57 years of remaining life!
The lifespan here, could it be the real lifespan...
If it were any other game, Mu You would never have such unwarranted associations, but in this weird game in front of him, he wouldn't be surprised at what happened.
So, he has 57 years left to live?
And if this guess is true, that is to say, every time he dies in this game, he will permanently lose one year of life...
Really, Kryptonian game!
He said how could this game be so generous? It gave him a magical pocket watch at the beginning, but it turned out that the price was to risk his life!
Mu You took a breath, and these thoughts passed through his mind in a flash. Seeing that the time was about to exceed five seconds, he hurriedly pressed the switch of his pocket watch.
Everything around him flowed backwards again, instantly returning to the state it was in five seconds ago.
The options in the game also return to the fork in the road just now.
However, this game seems to be able to sense that the pocket watch has reversed time. The text does not change back directly, but quietly changes.
[Lucky Fool, your relic saved your life and prevented your death. 】
[Time goes back, you are back at the intersection just now, please make your choice again. 】
There are still three options at the bottom: left, center, and right.
Knowing that there were bats on the left, Mu You certainly would not send them off again. This time he chose to go to the right.
[You chose to embark on this desolate path on the right. 】
[There are no obstacles ahead, and it seems to be a smooth road. 】
[A black-spotted spider suddenly jumps out from the roadside, and its sticky web rushes towards you, making you unable to move. 】
[You were bitten to death by a black-spotted spider! 】
【You are dead! Lifespan -1, remaining lifespan is 57 years. 】
Damn, guessed wrong again?
Mu You was dumbfounded.
The correct answer is actually the fugitive in the middle?
...Or is it that even the fugitives are wrong? There is no correct answer to this option at all. Whoever chooses will die?
No matter, let’s look back first!
[Time goes back and you once again return to the familiar three-way intersection. 】
[Continuous death setbacks have not defeated you, so, Fool, which way are you going to go this time? 】
Mu You clicked 'Center' nervously.
[You choose to walk towards the fugitive in the middle, asking for help from a distance, hoping that he can take you back to the village. But in the eyes of the frightened fugitive, the approach of anyone at this time will only make him more emotional. He raised the ax and looked into your eyes, with murderous intent surging...]
As soon as this text appeared, Mu You felt something bad: I'm afraid it's going to happen again!
Fortunately, it's not over yet.
[Unfortunately, this fugitive was a coward and did not dare to take action in the end. Seeing you approaching, he fled the scene in a panic. You survived. 】
"Damn, what do you mean 'it's a pity'? I'm disappointed that I survived, aren't you?"
Mu You cursed secretly, and at the same time he breathed a long sigh of relief.
Although this gameAlthough the copywriter has a bit of a bad mouth, it seems to be a bit low-end, and there is no real death option for him.
By the way, this opening option is too confusing, which means he can go back in time to avoid losses.
Thinking of this, Mu You couldn't help but feel even more satisfied with the 'Time Pocket Watch' he had randomly received: It seemed that he had randomly received a quite incredible relic by accident!
This text adventure game originally allows players to make choices one by one in the text, and each choice will bring different results.
And being able to go back infinitely means that he is guaranteed to make the best choice for any option he encounters in the game!
Is there anything more suitable for this game than this ability?
